value.rationale: A physically motivated fast-cycle control question exhibits a nontrivial singular balance: incomplete relaxation penalizes rates by 1/r while excessive resets penalize by tau^2 r^2. The sharp all-maximizer 2/3 scaling and two-term maximum are not routine substitution or a numerical optimum; they provide a parameter-uniform structural asymptotic and distinguish best resetting from no resetting. Its validity is expressly restricted to mechanical quench output, avoiding ungrounded net-engine claims.
